pr_title: GameEngine: define preview asset residency and streaming
pr_body:
## Summary

- add ADR 0136 for project-scoped CPU asset residency shared by Editor previews
- require background import/materialization result reuse and device-scoped GPU residency
- move preview renderer warm-up out of window-open latency
- define asynchronous cold loading with prioritized, frame-budgeted GPU uploads
- register ADR 0135/0136 in the ADR index

## Scope

Documentation/design only. No Editor/runtime implementation changes are included.
